candidate.title: TIF-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina schematic of TIF-Seq (transcript isoform sequencing), specifically its TAP-based RNA oligo-capping route, separate A/B chimera-control full-length cDNA preparations, circularization/fragmentation, and capture/library preparation. The biological targets are capped, polyadenylated transcripts (labeled mRNA); the sequenced carrier is a cDNA junction fragment linking transcript ends. This is a schematic architecture, not a complete protocol or a claim that the whole transcript is sequenced. Oligo-capping is an embedded component; the uncapped comparison and A/B preparations are not separate target methods. The matching collection-page heading supports the target identity, but its differently simplified schematic does not replace the assigned PNG. Unshown non-cap T4-PNK adaptations, long-RNA enrichment, and validation by RNA circularization are outside this extraction.

operations.description: Capture biotin-containing junction fragments with streptavidin, enrich the fragments carrying the linked transcript ends, and construct an Illumina-compatible cDNA sequencing library.
